title: KRIS-Bench: Benchmarking Next-Level Intelligent Image Editing Models
reasoning: The KRIS-Bench benchmark explicitly evaluates models on their knowledge of religious and cultural contexts. This is categorized under the 'Humanities' and 'Social Science' sub-dimensions of Conceptual Knowledge, featuring tasks such as identifying and generating the 'most representative figure in Christianity' (Jesus) and adapting images for religious or cultural festivals like the Mid-Autumn Festival.
